components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, such as Render or Continue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4f46e5); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #4f46e5); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #4338ca); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #4338ca); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action, such as Choose a file or Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cbd5e1); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink-soft, #334155); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.06); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); background: var(--accent-soft, #eef2ff); color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #334155); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f1f5f9); color: var(--ink, #0f172a); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Filter boards by title">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cbd5e1); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f172a); font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring, rgb(79 70 229 / 0.2)); }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Board status, always with a text label.
components.html: Up to date Stale Invalid
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.05rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-ok { background: var(--ok-soft, #ecfdf3); color: var(--ok, #067647); } .ds-stale { background: var(--warn-soft, #fffaeb); color: var(--warn, #b54708); } .ds-invalid { background: var(--danger-soft, #fef3f2); color: var(--danger, #b42318); }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: Atlas entry linking to a board, with status and grounding coverage.
components.html: Checkoutfrom code
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f172a); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.06); transition: border-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; max-width: 20rem; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.06); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4f46e5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; flex: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-soft, #eef2ff); color: var(--accent, #4f46e5); } .ds-card-body { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; flex: 1; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #64748b); } .ds-bar { display: flex; height: 0.3rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-2, #f1f5f9); }

narrative.overview:
The viewer is the paper a blueprint is printed on: cool, neutral, and quiet, so the board and its annotations carry the page. The chrome around the canvas (header, toolbar, source panel) stays thin and slate-grey; colour is spent on meaning, never on decoration. Every place a claim is shown, its grounding is shown with it: backed by code, spec only, or unresolved, and whether the code has changed since.

Density is that of a working tool, not a marketing page: 15px body text, compact 36px controls, hairline borders. Light and dark themes are both first-class, switched by `data-theme` on `<html>` with a system-following default.

The indigo accent and the indigo-to-violet logo gradient are provisional. A rebrand is planned; until then they stay as they are, but nothing new should be built on them as identity.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate neutrals with one accent hue.
Semantic colour reserved for status and grounding.
Near-flat surfaces; depth appears on interaction.
Monospace for anything that is a path, id, ref or quote from code.
Every token defined once on `:root` and redefined under `[data-theme="dark"]`.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and spec blue mean grounding or status and nothing else. Never use them for decoration, and never show a status by colour alone: a text label always goes with it.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour token used in CSS exists in both themes. A literal colour in a rule is a bug.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: A surface gets `shadow-md` only while it is being hovered or otherwise interacted with. Nothing is lifted at rest.

dos: Do define every colour as a token on `:root` and again under `[data-theme="dark"]`.
Do pair every status or grounding colour with a text label.
Do use monospace for paths, ids, refs and quotes, and sentence case elsewhere.
Do keep controls at least 36px tall and keep the 2px accent focus outline visible on every focusable element, including visually hidden inputs behind a styled label.
Do keep all fonts and assets local; the page makes no third-party request.
donts: Don't use semantic colours (green, amber, red, spec blue) for decoration.
Don't write literal colours in rules; use the tokens.
Don't lift surfaces at rest; shadows respond to interaction.
Don't extend the indigo accent or the logo gradient into new identity work before the rebrand.
Don't put `muted` text on `surface-2`; use `ink-soft` there.
